description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Fire Ability Boost, Triplecast Fire, Unlimited Fire Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Fire Abilities, Fire Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Fire Abilities; Ends after using 8 Fire abilities
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Fire/NE piercing ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Imperil Fire 0/40%
WS Blue: Imperil Fire 30% to all enemies
WS Gold: DeProtect 20% to all enemies
